Integration source check:
A text SequenceMatcher compared donor generate.cpp against new parent's generate.cpp before any edit. All differences were inserts, and the full insert text was inspected: include, frozen flag/sink/startup gate, request vector/effective max_new refusal, quota reservation, actual resume guard, effective first-window guard, normal-window copy block, and successful completion publication. No unrelated algorithm replacement/deletion appeared. Thus6035 generate is unchanged from pre-capture parent for relevant source; donor capture implementation copied, then raw spec guard correction below applied only in new tree.

Intentional semantic correction relative to capturev1:
Removed startup o.spec != 1 refusal and changed diagnostic reason to effectiveT1/max_new1. The original guard confused capacity with effective window length. Actual ordinary serve creates Verifier using max(o.spec,o.batch), generate.cpp:6192ff in parent. Verifier::init verify.cpp:238ff rejects max_t<2. Therefore donor's rawspec1 requirement was incompatible with this Verifier's serve initialization; this integration corrects it before any Main execution. Raw canonical --spec4 remains usable and is recommended for unchanged buffer geometry. Other already-supported raw capacity values remain subject to existing parser/Verifier validation.

Source evidence for effective behavior:
- Ordinary serve S=o.spec and S_mtp are capacity/draft limits, generate.cpp:7388ff in parent.
- First serial window computes T = use_mtp ? ... : 1 and independently first_window forcesT1, parent10249ff. Suffix/lookup/MTP/pipeline are disabled by capture gate. max_new1 allows only this first window; no capacity-sized proposal or subsequent history feedback exists.
- Capture still strictly checks actual first_window, produced_n0, request max_new1, effectiveT1, p=P-1, resume0, use_mtp false, from_sfx false, chain_n0 and successful retired/nonfailed phase before Verifier::run. Rawspec4 does not weaken this guard.
- Verifier::capture dispatch decisions use actual T; max_t_ is used in buffer extents/offsets/strides. No new arithmetic/launch/sampling algorithm change is introduced. This is source reasoning, not proof of numerical equivalence across capacity settings. Main should retain canonical rawspec4 for capture comparisons and record raw/effective values separately. No quality-only rawspec1 configuration difference remains; opt-in capture/IO is the diagnostic difference.

Strict copy synchronization audit (new tree unchanged APIs):
- Verifier::copy_logits verify.cpp:2346ff delegates split if present (capture forbids split), validates head/host/t>=0/vocab, then calls gpu::copy for exactly vocab*sizeof(float). It does NOT itself validate an upper t bound, so caller's literal0 and successful T1 are material guards.
- gpu::copy src/core/gpu.cpp:244ff submits memcpy on current Runtime compute queue, records service-copy metadata, calls rt().wait(event,"synchronous copy"), returns true only after wait succeeds; exceptions return fail("copy",e), i.e. false. include/strata/core/gpu.hpp documents synchronous/order-after-compute behavior.
- Runtime::wait src/core/device.cpp:494ff calls event.wait_and_throw() then check_async(). Driver wait has a watchdog-owned waiter; source comments say stuck wait exits instead of throwing/freeing pending USM. True return therefore checks copy event completion and asynchronous runtime errors, not merely submission.
- The Verifier graph uses its own cs_/copy_ streams. A compute-queue memcpy alone is NOT a blanket cross-stream ordering guarantee. Safety here also depends on successful Verifier::run: verify.cpp:1634ff checks cs_ and copy_ stream_sync before returning/readback; head sampling additionally syncs cs_ at1667ff if present. Caller performs commit then nonfinite_hit before capture. Thus completed producer precedes checked synchronous copy in the actual path. Existing last wait_commit and phase complete_gen precede file publication.
- False copy or thrown allocation/copy triggers existing phase_fatal/_Exit while local captured row and GPU owners remain alive; no return/unwind/free on uncertain copy. This is a source ownership argument. GPU/driver fault execution remains unverified.

Capture contract unchanged otherwise:
Exact flag1 plus explicit existing privateDIR, phase-cache/head-lease mandatory, ordinary fresh singleGPU no reuse/adaptation/drafting/batch/pipeline, requestmax_new1, actualT1/positionP-1; full FP32 finite vocabulary row through actualcopy_logits0; normal request/commit/phase completion required; checked exclusive.partial creation/write/flush/close/size and atomic exclusive hard-link.bin publication;64requests/64MiB total attempt reservations; request/P/position/row/T/reuse/completion stderr; OFF no diagnostic row allocation/copy/IO; no ordinary GEN/LP output changes.
Successful.partial remains another link to.bin for Main retention review, failed.partial never completed.bin. Requires filesystem hardlinks and C11 fopen wbx; no fsync/crash-durability or adversarial concurrent directory replacement claim. File completion is a capture event, not quality PASS or producer authentication.
